exam_set.title: Practice Set 2
exam_set.description: Textbook Practice — Book 1, Chapter 11, Practice Set 2

questions.jp: 共通鍵暗号方式の特徴はどれか。
questions.romaji: Kyōtsūkagi angō hōshiki no tokuchō wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which is a characteristic of symmetric-key cryptography?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 暗号化通信に使用する場合、鍵を相手と共有する必要があり、事前に平文で送付することが推奨されている。
options.romaji: Angōka tsūshin ni shiyō suru baai, kagi o aite to kyōyū suru hitsuyō ga ari, jizen ni heibun de sōfu suru koto ga suishō sarete iru.
options.en: The key must be shared and should be sent beforehand in plaintext.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 暗号化通信をする相手が1人の場合、使用する鍵の個数は公開鍵暗号方式よりも多い。
options.romaji: Angōka tsūshin o suru aite ga hitori no baai, shiyō suru kagi no kosū wa kōkaikagi angō hōshiki yori mo ōi.
options.en: With one peer, it uses more keys than public-key cryptography.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 同じ程度の暗号強度をもつ鍵長を選んだ場合、公開鍵暗号方式と比較して、暗号化や復号に必要な時間が短い。
options.romaji: Onaji teido no angō kyōdo o motsu kagichō o eranda baai, kōkaikagi angō hōshiki to hikaku shite, angōka ya fukugō ni hitsuyō na jikan ga mijikai.
options.en: At comparable security, encryption and decryption are faster than public-key cryptography.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 鍵のペアを生成し、一方の鍵で文書を暗号化すると、他方の鍵でだけ復号することができる。
options.romaji: Kagi no pea o seisei shi, ippō no kagi de bunsho o angōka suru to, tahō no kagi de dake fukugō suru koto ga dekiru.
options.en: It creates a key pair; data encrypted with one can only be decrypted with the other.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
One shared secret key makes bulk encryption fast.

Technical breakdown:
Symmetric algorithms use the same secret key for encryption and decryption and are generally far faster than public-key algorithms for comparable security.

Japanese keywords to remember:
共通鍵暗号方式 = kyōtsūkagi angō hōshiki = symmetric-key cryptography
復号 = fukugō = decryption

Why the best solution works:
ウ states the principal performance advantage.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
The key must be shared securely, never recommended in plaintext.
イ:
One peer needs one shared key, not more than a public/private pair.
エ:
This describes public-key cryptography.

Memory trick:
Shared secret = fast, but key delivery is hard.

Correct answer: ウ

questions.jp: Xさんは、Yさんにインターネットを使って電子メールを送ろうとしている。電子メールの内容を秘密にする必要があるので、公開鍵暗号方式を使って暗号化して送信したい。電子メールの内容を暗号化するのに使用する鍵はどれか。
questions.romaji: X-san wa, Y-san ni intānetto o tsukatte denshi mēru o okurō to shite iru. Denshi mēru no naiyō o himitsu ni suru hitsuyō ga aru node, kōkaikagi angō hōshiki o tsukatte angōka shite sōshin shitai. Denshi mēru no naiyō o angōka suru no ni shiyō suru kagi wa dore ka.
questions.en: X wants to send Y confidential email using public-key encryption. Which key encrypts the email?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Lock mail with receiver Y's public lock; only Y's private key opens it.

Technical breakdown:
For confidentiality, sender encrypts using recipient's public key. Only the matching recipient private key decrypts.

Japanese keywords to remember:
公開鍵 = kōkaikagi = public key
秘密にする = himitsu ni suru = keep confidential

Why the best solution works:
ウ permits only Y to decrypt.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
X's public key targets X, not Y.
イ:
X's private key relates to signing, not recipient confidentiality.
エ:
Y's private key must remain with Y and is used for decryption.

Memory trick:
Confidentiality: encrypt with receiver public key.

Correct answer: ウ

questions.jp: 暗号方式に関する記述のうち、適切なものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Angō hōshiki ni kansuru kijutsu no uchi, tekisetsu na mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which statement about cryptographic methods is correct?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 共通鍵暗号方式は、多数の相手との通信の際、同一の暗号化鍵を用いても安全である。
options.romaji: Kyōtsūkagi angō hōshiki wa, tasū no aite to no tsūshin no sai, dōitsu no angōka kagi o mochiite mo anzen de aru.
options.en: Symmetric cryptography is safe using one identical key with many peers.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 公開鍵暗号方式では、暗号化鍵を通信相手へ秘密裏に配信する必要がある。
options.romaji: Kōkaikagi angō hōshiki de wa, angōka kagi o tsūshin aite e himitsuri ni haishin suru hitsuyō ga aru.
options.en: Public-key cryptography requires secret delivery of the encryption key.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 公開鍵暗号方式は、共通鍵暗号方式に比べて復号処理が単純かつ高速である。
options.romaji: Kōkaikagi angō hōshiki wa, kyōtsūkagi angō hōshiki ni kurabete fukugō shori ga tanjun katsu kōsoku de aru.
options.en: Public-key decryption is simpler and faster than symmetric decryption.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 通信の開始時に共通鍵を公開鍵暗号方式で暗号化して相手に送り、データの暗号化を共通鍵暗号方式で行う方法が実用化されている。
options.romaji: Tsūshin no kaishi-ji ni kyōtsūkagi o kōkaikagi angō hōshiki de angōka shite aite ni okuri, dēta no angōka o kyōtsūkagi angō hōshiki de okonau hōhō ga jitsuyōka sarete iru.
options.en: A practical method encrypts a symmetric key with public-key cryptography, then encrypts data symmetrically.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Public-key safely delivers a small session key; fast symmetric crypto protects bulk data.

Technical breakdown:
Hybrid encryption combines public-key key exchange with efficient symmetric data encryption, as used in TLS-like systems.

Japanese keywords to remember:
通信の開始時 = tsūshin no kaishi-ji = at communication start
実用化 = jitsuyōka = put into practical use

Why the best solution works:
エ accurately describes hybrid encryption.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Sharing one symmetric key widely increases compromise exposure and attribution problems.
イ:
A public encryption key need not be secret.
ウ:
Public-key operations are generally slower.

Memory trick:
Public key carries key; symmetric key carries data.

Correct answer: エ

questions.jp: データベースで管理されるデータの暗号化に用いることができ、かつ、暗号化と復号とで同じ鍵を使用する暗号化方式はどれか。
questions.romaji: Dētabēsu de kanri sareru dēta no angōka ni mochiiru koto ga deki, katsu, angōka to fukugō to de onaji kagi o shiyō suru angōka hōshiki wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which method can encrypt database data and uses the same key for encryption and decryption?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
AES uses one shared secret key both ways.

Technical breakdown:
AES is a symmetric block cipher suitable for stored-data encryption. Encryption and decryption use the same secret key.

Japanese keywords to remember:
同じ鍵 = onaji kagi = same key
暗号化と復号 = angōka to fukugō = encryption and decryption

Why the best solution works:
ア meets both encryption and same-key conditions.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ:
PKI is infrastructure, not an encryption algorithm.
ウ:
RSA is asymmetric and uses a key pair.
エ:
SHA-256 is a one-way hash, not reversible encryption.

Memory trick:
AES = symmetric; RSA = asymmetric; SHA = hash.

Correct answer: ア

questions.jp: 公開鍵暗号方式の暗号アルゴリズムはどれか。
questions.romaji: Kōkaikagi angō hōshiki no angō arugorizumu wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which is a public-key encryption algorithm?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
RSA uses separate public and private keys.

Technical breakdown:
RSA is an asymmetric algorithm supporting public-key encryption and signatures.

Japanese keywords to remember:
公開鍵暗号方式 = kōkaikagi angō hōshiki = public-key cryptography
暗号アルゴリズム = angō arugorizumu = encryption algorithm

Why the best solution works:
ウ is the only public-key algorithm listed.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
AES is symmetric.
イ:
KCipher-2 is a symmetric stream cipher.
エ:
SHA-256 is a hash function.

Memory trick:
RSA = public/private pair.

Correct answer: ウ

questions.jp: 非常に大きな数の素因数分解が困難なことを利用した公開鍵暗号方式はどれか。
questions.romaji: Hijō ni ōkina sū no soinsū bunkai ga konnan na koto o riyō shita kōkaikagi angō hōshiki wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which public-key cryptosystem relies on difficulty of factoring very large numbers?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
RSA is easy to build from two large primes but hard to break by factoring their product.

Technical breakdown:
RSA security is based on computational difficulty of factoring a modulus formed from large primes.

Japanese keywords to remember:
素因数分解 = soinsū bunkai = prime factorization
困難 = konnan = difficult

Why the best solution works:
エ maps directly to the factorization assumption.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
AES is symmetric and not based on factoring.
イ:
DH relies on discrete logarithms.
ウ:
DSA also relies on discrete logarithms.

Memory trick:
RSA → really large factors.

Correct answer: エ
